# playquoridor.online

> Free online Quoridor — the 2- or 4-player abstract strategy board game where you race pawns across a 9×9 grid and place walls to block opponents. Play in your browser, no download, no signup.

## Pages

- [Play](/): Lobby with Quick Match, ranked, private rooms, bot practice, and the live 4-player free-for-all mode.
- [About Quoridor](/about): Full rules, history, strategy tips, glossary and FAQ for the wall blocking board game.
- [Stats & leaderboard](/stats): Global ELO leaderboard and player standings.
- [Daily puzzle](/puzzle): Today's Quoridor tactics puzzle.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy policy.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service.
